title: Norm of infinite doubly stochastic matrices
summary: In finite dimensions, every doubly stochastic matrix has the $\ell^p$-operator norm equal to $1$ for all $1 \le p \le \infty$. However, in the infinite-dimensional setting, this property may fail since the norm can be strictly smaller than $1$ when $1<p<\infty$. In this paper, a complete characterization of infinite doubly stochastic matrices for which the norm remains equal to $1$ is obtained. More precisely, for $1<p<\infty$, it is shown that $$ \|D\|_{\ell^p(I)\to\ell^p(I)}=1 \quad\iff\quad Θ(D^*D)=1, $$ where $Θ$ measures the maximal average mass of a finite square submatrix.
